verdict: Broad AI/semi sold off ~3-6% on hot Sept CPI; FSLR +4% on tariff-floor catalyst; fundamentals intact with hyperscaler capex tracking $720-745B above baseline.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24-72h)

**Macro selloff hits semiconductors (Oct 14):** A hotter-than-expected September CPI print triggered a broad AI/semi flush. NVDA -3.6%, AMD -5.7%, MU -4%, AVGO -3.1%. Secondary factor cited for NVDA: intensifying Microsoft custom-chip competition narrative. Move is macro-driven, not sector-specific.

**FSLR +4% (Oct 14):** First Solar climbed on a Truist Buy call (target raised to $270) tied to the December 4, 2026 Section 232 tariff-floor reset. Price floors of $0.38/W on modules and $21/kg on polysilicon take effect Dec 4; FSLR as a US manufacturer is the clearest domestic beneficiary.

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM pricing:** TrendForce (Sept 30) guides Q4-26 conventional DRAM +10-15% QoQ, NAND +15-20% — decelerating from prior pace but still positive. HBM3E contracts up ~20% for full-year 2026. No fresh October print yet. *Decelerating but still up — mild bear vs. prior pace.*

**Signal 2 — HBM4 / capacity:** No October-specific news. All three suppliers (SKH, Samsung, MU) confirmed HBM4-certified for Vera Rubin. Samsung has allocated >50% of its 4nm capacity to HBM4 base-die. Correction-phase risk (post-2026) baseline thesis unchanged.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler capex:** Combined 2026 estimates now tracking $720-745B (Meta $125-145B, Alphabet $175-185B, Amazon $200-220B, MSFT $175-190B) — above baseline $600-700B. Q3 earnings season starting. No guide-down signal detected.

**Signal 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** AMD Helios (72x MI455X, 31 TB HBM4) entered full production with first customer shipments late Q3-26. Anthropic partnership: up to 2 GW of Instinct MI450/Helios, first 1 GW deploying 1H-27. Google TPU 8t/8i introduced. Amazon Trainium 4 in development for 2027.

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics:** Coherent won a large CPO purchase order (CW-laser based), initial revenue expected Q4-26 ramping in 2027. InP constraints persisted through earnings calls (Aug-Sept). MRVL acquired Polariton Technologies (April, plasmonics/silicon photonics from ETH Zurich) — still digesting strategically.

**Signal 6 — Solar:** Section 232 Dec 4 price floors confirmed (details above). No fresh polysilicon spot-price update found.

NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU, RMBS, MRAM, SNDK, WDC, STX, LITE, CIEN, ENPH, NXT, ARRY: No notable catalysts found in this scan window.

---

## Context vs. Baseline

Hyperscaler capex is running ~5-7% above the May-28 baseline ($720-745B vs. $600-700B). HBM pricing is decelerating but still positive — consistent with the baseline correction-risk flag for post-2026. AMD Helios entering production marks a milestone for custom-silicon share-shift. The Oct 14 selloff is macro (CPI), not a sector-demand deterioration.

---

| Macro (CPI) | Hot print | Bear for rate-sensitive semis |

---

## Most Important Development

Hot September CPI triggered a broad AI/semi selloff (NVDA -3.6%, AMD -5.7%, MU -4%) — but this is rate-driven, not demand-driven. Hyperscaler capex is tracking $720-745B, above baseline. The structural thesis remains intact; the selloff looks like a macro air-pocket, not a cycle turn. Watch Q3 hyperscaler earnings (Oct-Nov) for any demand signals.
